description: A Java class 'MediaDrmBridge' that wraps and manages Android's MediaDrm API for handling DRM sessions, key requests, provisioning, and media crypto creation, primarily supporting Widevine DRM scheme.

classes.name: UpdateSessionResult
classes.description: A helper class representing the result of updating a DRM session, indicating success or failure and an optional error message.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a MediaDrmBridge instance with Widevine scheme if supported, initializes MediaCrypto.

methods.name: isWidevineCryptoSchemeSupported
methods.description: Checks if Widevine DRM scheme is supported on the device.

methods.name: isCbcsSchemeSupported
methods.description: Checks if 'cbcs' encryption scheme is supported, considering Android version.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Releases resources and cleans up the MediaDrmBridge instance.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates a new DRM session with provided init data and mime type, handles provisioning if needed.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Provides a key response to update an existing DRM session, returns success or failure.

methods.name: closeSession
methods.description: Closes a specified DRM session and removes it from tracking.

methods.name: getMetricsInBase64
methods.description: Retrieves DRM metrics encoded in Base64 if supported.

methods.name: getMediaCrypto
methods.description: Returns the MediaCrypto object associated with this DRM session.
